title: Hostel room allotment

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: our own project brief, code, tests and rubric for hostel room allotment, examples, code, quiz and explanations; no text from any site, book or course.

brief: The hostel office allots beds by hand on a register. Build the logic behind a simple allotment tool: rooms with a number of beds, students placed in the lowest-numbered room that has space, students leaving, and a room-by-room view. You write one class; the driver turns typed commands into calls.
requirements: Rooms have a number and a bed count; a room number can be added once.
A student is placed in the lowest-numbered room with a free bed (first fit), and only once.
Vacating frees the bed; the student can be allotted again later.
SHOW lists every room by number with its students sorted by name and its free beds.
io_protocol:
| Command | Prints |
|---|---|
| `ROOM <no> <beds>` | `room <no> added with <beds> beds` or `error: room <no> exists` |
| `ALLOT <student>` | `<student> -> room <no>`, `error: <student> already in room <no>`, or `error: hostel full` |
| `VACATE <student>` | `<student> left room <no>` or `error: <student> not found` |
| `SHOW` | `room <no>: <names> (<free> free)` per room (`-` when empty), or `no rooms` |

Anything else: `error: bad command <line>`.

milestones.title: Rooms and first-fit allotment
milestones.instructions: Fill in `addRoom` and the happy path of `allot`: try rooms in increasing number and take the first with a free bed.
hints: Map keys come out in insertion order, not numeric order: sort them.
Keep a second Map from student to room so later commands are O(1).

milestones.title: Errors and vacating
milestones.instructions: Refuse a second allotment for the same student, report a full hostel, and implement `vacate`.
hints: Check the student first: an already-placed student gets their room number in the error even if the hostel is full.

milestones.title: The room view
milestones.instructions: Return one line per room from `show`, rooms by number, names sorted, free beds counted.
hints: [...set].sort().join(', ') gives the names; print '-' when the room is empty.

rubric.criterion: Hidden tests pass: every command prints exactly the expected output.
RoomRegistry keeps rooms and student positions consistent: every allot and vacate updates both maps together.
Readable names, small functions and clear error handling (AI feedback, advice only).

extensions: Add MOVE <student> <room> that keeps the old bed if the new room is full.
Print the occupancy percentage of the hostel.
